Does 'simple path' mean no repeated vertices, and if so, are we to consider all such paths or just one (e.g., the path with minimum XOR)?
Is the output a single integer, or should we output multiple integers (one per path)?
If there are multiple simple paths, do we need to compute the XOR of edge labels for each path and then combine them (e.g., XOR all path XORs together)?
Are we allowed to use the same edge multiple times across different paths when considering all simple paths?
